beats.en: A decimal like 27.53 has 2 tens, 7 ones, 5 tenths and 3 hundredths. Fractions with denominators 10, 100, 1000 and so on are easy to write as decimals. For example 254 over 1000 is 200/1000 + 50/1000 + 4/1000, which is 0.
